title: Implement branch-aware event store
description: Persist typed goal events in Pi custom entries and reconstruct selected branch through the reducer. Add bounded validation and compact snapshot support only if needed. Acceptance: replay, corruption, branch, restart, and duplicate-event tests pass.

logs.msg: Implemented extensions/pi-goal/store.ts with typed pi-goal/event replay, snapshot checkpoints, event ID deduplication, branch selection, and bounded validation. Tests: store.test.ts.
